snippet.title: Cats Away Announcement Trailer - ARRRiving July 10!
snippet.description:
Get all paws on deck for CATS AWAY, the real-time strategy game with talking cats, sailing sweethearts and exciting sea battles! Coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Steam on July 10, 2025. 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cats-away-switch/
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10007182
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389020/Cats_Away/
https://www.nicalis.com/games/catsaway
